_comment: Espejo en fichero del pricing pay-per-event. Apify lo configura en Console > Actor > Monetization; estos son los valores exactos a pegar ahi (nombres de evento identicos a los que cobra src/main.py).

actor-start.eventDescription: One charge per run. Covers the 12 MB download from the ministry API and the parsing of all ~11.500 stations.

station-result.eventDescription: One charge per station returned in the dataset, cleaned, ranked and with its price delta.

history-snapshot.eventDescription: One charge per run that appends the day's prices to the cumulative history dataset.

price-alert.eventDescription: One charge per station found at or below the requested price threshold.
